_comment_regions: Same region as the admin dashboard and the Supabase project.
Most of this site is static and served from the CDN regardless, so this
matters less here than it does for the dashboard. It matters for the parts
that are not: the auth action handler and /auth/continue both talk to
Supabase on the server, and those are exactly the moments a visitor is
waiting on a redirect with nothing to look at.
Keep this in step with admin-dashboard/vercel.json — two properties
drifting to two regions is how one of them silently gets slower.
See that file for how to verify the Supabase region.
